scope: Trusted parent continuation after verified API startup under the existing host release lock
behavior: No standalone CLI flag, executable-path input or serialized success receipt enables a continuation
A configured continuation must be callable before private configuration reads
All database stages, API readiness and boundary checks complete and retain durable receipts before the continuation
The same release/watchdog flock remains held throughout the continuation
The parent receives private snapshot/attempt paths and copies of release/API outcome values
Callback return values do not authorize traffic or qualify the API receipt as release acceptance
Continuation failure stops API runtime under the lock and retains separate failure evidence without erasing prior database/API receipts

newCases: After durable runtime success, callback observes the held lock, full runtime and all three database receipts; mutations of callback copies do not alter returned result
Callback failure stops runtime and preserves independent database/API success plus separate failure evidence
Invalid callback refused before private reads
Failed API boundary verification never invokes callback
